ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Each of these passes within half a day. If they keep coming, they wear on the heart: the heart section below says what wore on them most, and that is the thing to change.

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.keep: Each lifts them for half a day, and a run of them eases the heart: time with friends, a varied table and the small kindnesses of colony life keep them coming.
